rules: Use only newly-created QA-PILOT entities; never select existing first user/item.
Generate random passwords at seed time; do not store plaintext in Git.
Mark all records by unique run ID; cleanup only records owned by that run.
Use a synthetic department, shift, employee, item, warehouse and locations.
